About

I've spent the last nine years on the backend end of the web — architecting Laravel and Symfony systems, building REST and GraphQL APIs, and keeping databases and infrastructure running the way they should. Over time that expanded into React and Next.js, so I can take a product from data model to finished interface without handing it off halfway.

Recently that's meant folding AI tools like Cursor and Claude into the workflow — not to replace judgement, but to move faster through the parts of the job that don't need a human's full attention, and spend more of it on architecture and code quality.
